launcher.title: shoebox launcher
launcher.sub: Your photo library on this drive. Nothing is copied or changed in your photos.
launcher.root.label: Drives or photo folders (type a path, press Enter to add it)
launcher.drives.has_lib: A check mark marks drives that already have a shoebox library.
launcher.drives.none: No drives found automatically: type the path of your drive or photo folder.
launcher.kind.scan.desc: find new, moved and changed photos
launcher.kind.verify.desc: check that nothing was lost or damaged
launcher.kind.recognize.desc: find the faces in your photos
launcher.kind.backup.desc: is the 2nd ticked folder a complete copy of the 1st ticked?
launcher.opt.quick: Quick (Scan: skip full hashes · Verify: size and date only)
launcher.opt.rotated: Recognize: also look for faces lying down (slower)
launcher.opt.deep: Backup check: also re-read the backup drive (finds bit rot; slow)
launcher.app.idle: The photo app starts only when you press this button. Scan first if this is a new drive.
launcher.app.running_end: . Stop it to scan, verify or change folders.
launcher.need_ticked: Tick at least one folder first.
launcher.backup_need_two: Backup check needs exactly two ticked folders: the first is the original, the second the copy.
launcher.backup_of.title: A backup check on {date} found it to be a complete copy of {path}
launcher.reveal_both: Show this file on both drives in Finder / Explorer
launcher.cleanup.found: Still on the backup {backup}: {n} files you removed with the duplicates screen.
launcher.cleanup.forever: Delete for good (skip the backup's trash folder)
launcher.cleanup.button: Delete duplicates from backup as well
launcher.cleanup.confirm: Move the removed duplicates ({n}) to the trash folder of the backup {backup}? The copies that stay on the backup are not touched.
launcher.cleanup.confirm_forever: Delete the removed duplicates ({n}) from the backup {backup} for good? This cannot be undone. The copies that stay on the backup are not touched.
launcher.sum.backup_removed: {n} removed here, still on the backup
launcher.arrivals.found: {n} of the new files were already on {drive}. The older copies stay where they are.
launcher.arrivals.found_many: {n} of the new files were already on these drives. The older copies stay where they are.
launcher.arrivals.tags_hint: The folder names of the deleted copies are saved as tags on the older originals.
launcher.arrivals.forever: Delete for good (skip the trash folder)
launcher.arrivals.confirm: Move the {n} new copies that were already on the drive to the library's trash? The older copies are not touched.
launcher.arrivals.confirm_forever: Delete the {n} new copies that were already on the drive for good? This cannot be undone. The older copies are not touched.
launcher.reveal_failed: the file manager could not be started
launcher.cancelled: {name} was cancelled (what was done is kept)
settings.allow_trash_hint: Off by default, so shoebox never touches your originals. When on, the photo view shows a trash icon and the selection in the timeline offers “Move to trash”. Trashed photos can be put back until the trash is emptied.
lb.rotate_hint: Rotate left (r) · Option-click or Shift+R: right
lb.rotate_view_hint: Rotate left (r) · Option-click or Shift+R: right · in shoebox only, the file stays as it is
lb.rotate_view_only: Turned in shoebox only. The file itself is not changed, so Finder and other apps show it as before.
info.add_face_turned: Turn the photo back first: boxes are drawn on the photo as the file has it
login.text: Enter the PIN shown in the terminal where shoebox is running.
login.local_only: This shoebox only accepts connections from its own computer. Restart it with --lan to allow other devices.
chip.add: Add a tag, person, pet or folder to the search
info.open_in_hint: Tags, faces, moving and the rest are done in the photo's own drive
info.name: Name
info.estimated_hint: Not the date the photo was taken
info.no_date_created: No capture date, not in an event folder: the file’s created date, the earliest date known
info.no_date_folder: No capture date; month of the event folder
info.no_date_file: No capture date, not in an event folder: the file’s modification date, the earliest date known
status.no_ffmpeg: no ffmpeg: video previews made by the browser
sel.hint_mouse: Click photos to select, Shift-click for a range
move.title: Move
move.keep_hint: The photos’ own (manual) tags always move along. Folder tags follow the new folder. Checked: the old folder’s tags also stay on the photos as own tags.
move.hint: Folders that do not exist yet are created. RAW, Live Photo and sidecar files of the same name move along. Nothing is ever overwritten.
move.skipped: Some photos stayed where they were
trash.text: Move {count} (with their RAW, Live Photo and sidecar files) to the shoebox trash? You can put them back from there until the trash is emptied.
trash.skipped: Some photos were not moved to the trash
rename.title: Rename folder
rename.hint: Change the name, or the whole path to move the folder. Event folders are named “{pattern}” (set in Settings).
dups.kind.resolution.hint: The same picture in another size, quality or name (a messenger copy, say).
dups.kind.edited.hint: An iPhone edit (the “E” in IMG_E1234, a portrait blur, say) next to its original. Keep the one you like, or both.
dups.kind.similar.hint: Different shots that look alike: a series, repeated clicks, a burst.
dups.title: Duplicates
dups.across.some: {count} on more than one drive ({drives}). Move the copy you do not need to the trash of its drive.
dups.across.none_in: No photo exists on more than one drive ({drives}).
dups.across.none: No photo exists on more than one drive.
dups.cross_trash.one: Move this copy on {name} ({path}) to the trash of that drive? The same photo stays on the other drive. You can put it back from the trash until it is emptied.
dups.cross_trash.other: Move this copy on {name} ({path}) to the trash of that drive? The same photo stays on the other drives. You can put it back from the trash until it is emptied.
dups.sub: Tick “delete this copy” on the files to remove; of every photo the best file is left unticked and one file per group always stays. Decided groups are not shown again.
dups.none: No duplicates. Photos added since the last scan are compared once they have thumbnails.
dups.none_kinds: No duplicates of the chosen kinds.
dups.same_folder_hint: Deletes {count}: identical copies in the same folder as another copy. The best one stays, no review.
dups.same_folder_none: No identical copies in the same folder.
dups.lower_hint: Deletes {count}: the same photo in a lower resolution or without its metadata (a messenger copy, say). The better file stays, no review.
dups.lower_none: No lower-quality versions of a photo.
dups.preselect_hint: Tick what the page suggests: of every photo the identical and the clearly worse copies, never the best file.
dups.preselect_edited_hint: Tick the edited versions, so every original stays.
settings.copy_folders_hint: Files inside a folder with one of these names (at any level) count as copies, not originals: when the same photo lies elsewhere, the copy is ticked and the other one stays. For example “Links”, where a packaged InDesign project keeps its photos.
dups.compare_title: Which one do you like most?
dups.kept_versions: Kept as versions of one photo
dups.group_hint_series: {hint} Every card is one file; click a picture to compare them large.
dups.lower_quality: lower quality than the best version
dups.same_letter: Files with the same letter are identical
dups.delete_text: Move {count} to the shoebox trash? In every group at least one copy stays. The tags and the capture date of a deleted copy are added to the copy that stays (as tags you can remove again). You can put the copies back from the trash.
dups.skipped: Some copies were not moved to the trash
dups.dates.text: These photos have copies with different capture dates. Which date should the photo that stays have? (Stored in the library only; the file is not changed.)
dups.dates.title: Capture dates differ
dups.lower.title: Remove lower-quality versions
dups.lower.text: {copies} (of {photos}) are surely the same photo as a better file: the same picture with fewer pixels or without the capture date, as after sending it by messenger. They go to the shoebox trash without review; the better file stays. Folders, tags and capture dates of the removed copies are carried over to it. Photos that merely look alike (other shots of a series) are never touched.
dups.lower.done: {copies} moved to the trash, {tags} carried over
dups.same.title: Remove exact duplicates
dups.same.text: {copies} ({photos}) have identical content to another file in the same folder. They go to the shoebox trash without review; in each folder one stays: the highest resolution, and the one with the original name rather than “IMG_1 (2)” or “IMG_1 - Copy”. Similar photos and copies in other folders are not touched. Tags and capture dates are carried over to the copy that stays.
trash.page_sub: {count} in .shoebox/trash on the drive. Put them back, or delete them for good.
trash.delete_text: Delete {count} (with their companion files) from the drive? This cannot be undone.
tags.folder_hint: Folder tag: comes from where the photo is
tags.add_hint: Tags are kept in shoebox’s index, never written into the photos. Names are matched ignoring case.
tags.none_own: None of these photos has an own tag. Folder tags come from where a photo is; move it to change them.
facecheck.widths: Widths in the copy the recognizer saw: {widths}.
facecheck.none: No faces here. `shoebox recognize` finds them.
facecheck.undo_hint: It is a face (undo “not a face”)
facecheck.similar_hint: Cosine similarity of the embeddings (1 = identical), most similar first. Click a face to open its photo.
people.delete_text: Delete “{name}”? Nobody is confirmed as them, so no photo changes.
people.group_hint: A person is in one group at most. On a computer you can also drag people onto a group.
people.merge_hint: All faces of {name} (and the photos they are on) become that person’s; {name} is removed. The other person keeps their name and group.
people.delete_group_some: {count} in it will be in no group; nobody is deleted.
people.nobody_named: Nobody is named yet. Name faces under “Unnamed”, or in the info panel of a photo.
people.group_empty_hint: Nobody in it yet: “Move to group…” on a person, or drag one here.
person.sub.confirmed: Faces named {name}, largest first. Select some to take them out (“Not {name}”) or give them another name.
person.sub.suggested: Faces that look like {name} (from all confirmed faces), most similar first. ✓ confirms, ✗ says it is someone else.
person.sub.maybe: Faces that might be {name}, less sure than the suggestions. ✓ confirms, ✗ says it is someone else.
person.sub.rejected: Faces marked “not {name}”. They are never suggested for {name} again; ↺ undoes that.
person.missing: This person does not exist (any more).
person.name: Name
unnamed.summary: {faces} without a name, in {clusters} of similar faces, largest first. Name a card, or say they are strangers (Ignore) or no faces at all. “Select” names only some faces of a card.
unnamed.done: Every face large enough has a name (or is ignored). New photos bring new ones after `shoebox recognize`.
unnamed.ignore_hint: Strangers, or faces in pictures, posters and screens: nobody needs to name them
unnamed.notface_hint: False finds: no face at all
unnamed.select_hint: Name, ignore or mark only some faces of this card
unnamed.name_all: Name all {size} faces of this card {name}
unnamed.only_hint: Name only the {n} faces recognised as {name}; the other {rest} stay unnamed
unnamed.regrouped: These faces were regrouped in the meantime; here are the cards as they are now.
info.faces_unlooked: Not looked at for faces yet (shoebox recognize).
info.add_face_hint: Draw a box around a face or a pet that was missed
draw.hint: Drag a box around the face or pet
draw.note: The box is kept in shoebox’s index, never written into the photo. Its face is learned for suggestions when the recognizer finds its eyes, nose and mouth in it.
draw.title: Add face or pet
drives.all_hint: One timeline over every drive that is not a backup
drives.offline_text: This drive is not connected. Plug it in and it opens by itself; nothing was changed. The other drives in the list on the left keep working.
drives.page_sub: Each drive keeps its own library. Here they are compared, without copying anything.
drives.looks_backup: {name} looks like a backup of {other}: almost everything on it is on the other drive too. Until you decide, it is left out of the common timeline and the duplicates across drives.
drives.no_backup: No, it has its own photos
drives.status: {photos} on {drives} · for looking; open a photo’s drive to change things
drives.backup_all: {backup} is a backup of {primary}: it holds all {files}.
drives.backup_some: {backup} is a backup of {primary}: {files} not on it yet{different}.
drives.backup_last: Last backup: {last} (new files last arrived); the backup drive was scanned {scan}. Scan it after every backup to bring this up to date.
drives.backup_unhashed: {files} of {primary} have no full hash yet and are not compared.
drives.backup_extra: {files} only on the backup (gone or changed on {primary}).
facecheck.undo_hint_pet: It is a pet (undo “not a pet”)
facecheck.similar_hint_pet: Cosine similarity of the embeddings (1 = identical), most similar first. Click a pet to open its photo.
facecheck.none_pets: No pets here. `shoebox recognize --pets` (or “Recognize pets” in the launcher) finds them.
settings.title: Settings
settings.calibration_hint: Look at what recognition found in your photos: sizes, scores, nearest neighbours and false finds. Nothing here changes a photo.
settings.faces_desc: People’s faces: how many were found, how small they are, which look alike.
settings.pets_desc: Cats and dogs: how many were found, how small they are, which look alike.
settings.not_yet_pets: Not looked for yet: `shoebox recognize --pets`, or “Recognize pets” in the launcher.
people.calibration_hint: Face check and pet check, in Settings
unnamed.summary_pets: {faces} without a name, in {clusters} of similar pets, largest first. Name a card, or say they are strangers (Ignore) or no pets at all. “Select” names only some pets of a card.
unnamed.done_pets: Every cat and dog large enough has a name (or is ignored). New photos bring new ones after `shoebox recognize --pets`.
draw.is_pet: This is a pet (a cat or a dog)
draw.note_pet: The box is kept in shoebox’s index, never written into the photo. The whole pet in the box is learned for suggestions.
launcher.kind.recognize_pets.desc: find cats and dogs; they show up among the faces
types.label: Type
unnamed.notface_hint_pet: False finds: no pet at all
facecheck.pet_faces: {count} taken for a pet’s face (not listed)
unnamed.singles_hint: Alone or in pairs, nothing similar found. Tap the ones that belong together (Shift-tap for a range), then name, ignore or mark them below; ↗ opens the photo. With the keyboard: Tab between faces, Enter selects, Space opens the photo and closes it again.
facecheck.unmatched: Not matched yet: {count} (no name, nobody suggested), by width: {widths}.
pattern.name: Name
settings.event_pattern_hint: How the app names a new event folder, for example when you move photos into a new folder. Year first, then month, then the event name. Existing folders are not renamed, and every form here is recognised when scanning, so older folders keep their date.
